title: Beyond Two Tracks: Speaker-Anchored Full-Duplex Dialogue Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.27109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spoken interaction is moving from alternating turns to full-duplex conversation, where an agent listens while speaking. Learning this coordination requires natural dialogue with persistent speaker-resolved tracks, a data requirement that remains difficult to satisfy at scale. Generative recovery offers a route from ordinary recordings, but recovering two voices is not enough: their track assignments can drift as the conversation unfolds. We address this missing link with speaker-anchored routing before diffusion: a 1.84M-parameter module matches the separator's coarse streams to fixed enrollment identities and orders them before a frozen generator reconstructs the speech, without retraining the generator or altering the reconstructed audio. On 25-minute remote conversations, routing cuts wrong-track time from 43.9% to 4.1%, below the 6.2% of matched-enrollment waveform re-identification, with its largest advantage when one participant

translated_title: 超越双声道：面向说话人锚定的全双工对话恢复
translated_abstract: 口语交互正从轮流发言转向全双工对话，即智能体在说话的同时进行聆听。学习这种协同配合需要带有持久说话人分离声道的自然对话数据，而这一数据需求在大规模场景下仍难以满足。生成式恢复提供了一条从普通录音出发的路径，但仅恢复出两个声音还不够：随着对话的展开，它们的声道归属可能发生漂移。我们通过在扩散之前的说话人锚定路由来弥补这一缺失环节：一个仅有184万参数的模块将分离器输出的粗略声流与固定的注册身份进行匹配并排序，随后由冻结的生成器重建语音，全程无需重新训练生成器，也不会改变重建后的音频。在25分钟的远程对话中，路由将错误声道时间从43.9%降至4.1%，低于基于匹配注册的波形重识别方法的6.2%，其最大优势出现在其中一名参与者……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在扩散生成之前进行说话人锚定路由，用一个仅184万参数的轻量模块将分离出的声流匹配并排序到固定的注册身份，把全双工对话重建中的错误声道时间从43.9%降至4.1%，且无需重新训练冻结的生成器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes speaker-anchored routing before diffusion, using a lightweight 1.84M-parameter module to match and order separated speech streams to fixed enrollment identities, cutting wrong-track time in full-duplex dialogue reconstruction from 43.9% to 4.1% without retraining the frozen generator.
